behavior: A social, nomadic finch that forages in noisy flocks, clinging acrobatically—sometimes upside down—to cones, branch tips, and seed heads. Its flight is undulating, and winter movements are highly erratic in response to seed availability.
field_marks: Brown-and-cream plumage with heavy, fine streaking
Yellow edging and patches on the dark wings
Short, distinctly notched tail with yellow edging
habitat: Open coniferous and mixed forests, especially edges and clearings; also deciduous woodland, scrubby thickets, weedy fields, grasslands, parks, gardens, and other semi-open areas with abundant seeds.
